overallNotes: Ariana Celeste Batiste is a 34-year-old archivist at Tremé Heritage Center in New Orleans on a mission to preserve 450+ neighborhood oral histories. Across 30 slices (2025-2028), she evolves from emergency triage to stewardship of a durable public archive. Original metadata had pervasive issues: all emotional_tone set to 'neutral' despite many slices being clearly positive, negative, or mixed; foci were truncated fragments of first user lines rather than true summaries; summaries were quote fragments; tags were generic (work, family, health) instead of content-specific; open_loops were missing entirely; quality notes were absent. This enrichment corrects all fields with slice-specific precision. Key arc: mold discovery → grant win → intake reform → relationship boundary work → field recording → AC failure → infrastructure approval → burnout and counseling → public listening events → database launch → 450-recording milestone. Emotional trajectory spans alarm, hope, exhaustion, pride, and hard-won steadiness.
